baseline: First-round working-tree implementation remeasured before simplification; before values match round1-results.json after values
goal: Reduce cross-function balance coupling and conditional return semantics, accepting explicitly measured gas and size costs
measurement: vm.snapshotGasLastCall with --isolate; last contract call only, not whole-test gas or mainnet transaction fee
deployment_blocker: AdaptiveLPVault runtime remains 2533 bytes above EIP-170, 249 bytes worse than the first-round implementation
limitations: Local deterministic fixtures; vault V3/oracle/router and external AMMs use test stand-ins, not a fixed-block mainnet fork.
Simplification changes were measured together; do not assign the entire delta to individual balanceOf calls.
Production size uses independent forge build src outputs, not full-test artifacts; initcode excludes concrete constructor arguments.
The first-round working-tree baseline is not a separate git commit; historical results are retained rather than overwritten.
